title: SaS-Math AI Presentation Binding
description: DRAFT v0.1 — the art↔math bridge. Maps a game-config's stable integer symbol ids and the engine's closed set of event types to concrete art assets (Spine skeletons, atlas regions, spritesheet frames, sounds). PRESENTATION ONLY — kept entirely outside the certified-math core so the cert artifact stays pure (ADR-001). A binding is valid only if it is bidirectionally complete: every symbol id and every event type is bound, and nothing references an id/event that does not exist. Single source of truth for the Pydantic + TS binding types (ADR-004).

targets_config_hash.description: Optional content-hash (e.g. BLAKE3) of the math config this binding targets. Lets a build prove art and math are paired. Filled once configs are content-addressed.

symbols.description: One binding per game-config symbol id. Every symbol id MUST appear here, and each must resolve to at least one renderable asset (skeleton, atlas_region, or spritesheet).

land_anim.description: Animation when this symbol lands on the reels.

win_anim.description: Animation when this symbol is part of a win.

events.description: One binding per engine event type. Every event in the closed event-type set MUST be bound. The set mirrors the engine's RoundOutcome (line_win/scatter_win/cap_applied) plus the spin lifecycle.

blocking.description: Does the play sequence wait for this animation to finish?
